CAREERS AT AUTOMOX

Exciting tech.
Extraordinary people.

Calling all action takers, innovators, and problem solvers...

Let's build together.

Innovation shouldn't just be about technology. It should also frame the way we work with each other, shaping our values, culture, and community.

Automox delivers confidence in IT with its cloud-native platform driven by passionate, customer-obsessed people.

Our communities

Find your fellow foodies, horror movie buffs, pet lovers, and creatives in our Slack social groups.

You are the culture

Our teams are empowered to adopt an ownership mindset, make decisions, develop professionally, and grow their careers.


Community engagement & philanthropy

At Automox, we empower you to volunteer your time and talent in the community where you live and work. Automox also supports local charitable philanthropic efforts through annual financial contributions.

PERKS + BENEFITS

Advancing with purpose

Remote

Our distributed workplace builds teams by talent so that you can work with the best.

How we work

We lean in to solve important problems for our customers and believe in accountability to ourselves and teams. Our flexible PTO policy allows employees to lean out and recharge when they need it most.

Family matters

Whether you're growing your family through birth, adoption or other paths, our family planning benefits are here to support your journey through company supported adoption and IVF assistance and paid parental leave.

Creating connection

Meet teammates during new-hire cohorts, get to know senior leaders through company all hands, send a pic of your beloved fur baby in the 'Pets of Automox' Slack channel, and grab a virtual coffee - on us - through our connection stipend.

Wellness for everyone

We provide an inclusive range of wellness benefits to support you and your family's unique needs. With fully covered employee vision and dental plans, two medical options, company HSA contributions, 401(k) matching, and life insurance, choose the best fit for your lifestyle.

Set the scene

Feel at home at work… at home. Create your perfect home office using our work-from-home stipend.

CULTURE + PEOPLE

And the survey says...

We have a killer company culture. In a company-wide employee survey, 99% of respondents said Automox is a great place to work. It's time to meet your new favorite coworkers.

Join us as we build the cloud-native IT revolution.
